### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                     |
| ----- | ------ | --------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | down, lower area, underside |
| ~an   | *adj.* | low                         |
### Antonym
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/wi\|wi]]
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- 下 but the lower slanting line is replaced with half an arrow head.
- Arrowhead: compare to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/in\|in]]
- Not to be confused with 丁.
#### Sound
- *a priori:* w=water, o=falling
- pronouncing "wo" feels like the mouth is falling down
